title: Income-tax Act — Section 80G (Deduction in respect of donations to certain funds and charitable institutions)

content.overview: Section 80G allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in respect of donations to certain funds and charitable institutions.
content.glance: Section 80G allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in respect of donations to certain funds and charitable institutions.
content.study: Chapter VI-A deduction. Section 80G: Deduction in respect of donations to certain funds and charitable institutions. The deduction is allowed from gross total income subject to the conditions, limits and mode-of-payment rules in the section, and it cannot create a loss under the head.
